capabilities: Generate kanban columns automatically from any base property
Drag cards between columns to update their property values
Group the board into horizontal swimlanes using a second property
Create new cards with column and swimlane values pre-filled
Show card titles and cover images from frontmatter properties
extras: Installation is manual (download a release into .obsidian/plugins); cover-image settings are designed to mirror Obsidian's native Cards view so one frontmatter property works for both.
intentEvidence: A kanban-style drag-and-drop custom view for Obsidian Bases
motivation: The author was inspired by the need for better task management in Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases views have no kanban layout where moving a card between columns updates the note's property value.

relations.evidence: Built with SortableJS for drag-and-drop functionality

summary: Kanban board view for Obsidian Bases that organizes notes into draggable columns based on any property.
